与节日一起成长(Growing up with festivals): 一篇关于节日文化的B1记叙文:莉莉的经历、感受与成长。

On Saturday evenings, Lily reviews the notes from class. Lily ordered bread and juice at the holiday plan last night. At first, Lily found it difficult to keep the habit. My Iraqi classmate taught us some Arabic words.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Grace always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Mum and I baked cookies together.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The lantern street looked quieter than usual that evening. Lily plans to study music harder this term. Also, this brown bread has a lovely nutty flavour.

The holiday plan has become an important part of daily life. Lily believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Lily wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Best of all, she left a perfumed note on his pillow.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Lily thanked Grace for the honest advice. Lily has practiced table tennis for three years and won a prize last term.
